_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of windows producing ±2+ point moves and no confirmed breaker — funding neutral at 0.0094%, BTC 30d momentum flat at 0%, DXY weakness already priced — HOLD is the statistically honest call while awaiting confirmation that the coil is resolving upward.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing 0-for-18 forced calls in coils; narrative implies directional upside via accumulation framing without naming a breaker
